events.title: We're Joining Steam Next Fest! Play the Free Fish on the Floor Demo
events.summary: Hello from Works On My PC Studio! Fish on the Floor is joining Steam Next Fest: October 2026! The free demo is available to play now. Step into a fish market full of sea creatures scattered across the floor and find your own way to clean up the chaos. events.title: Thank you for playing the demo! First bug fixes
events.summary: Hello from the developer of Fish on the Floor! We released the demo yesterday, and more of you have stopped by to play than we expected. Thank you so much! Seeing you rescue the fish scattered across the floor and reading your feedback has been a huge encouragement. We have fixed the following issues found during play: Fish getting stuck inside buildings or tanks Fixed an issue where throwing or pushing fish could leave them inside scenery, unable to be picked up again. events.title: Devlog #1 — Bringing the Aquarium to Life
events.summary: Hello! Welcome to the first development diary for Fish on the Floor. Recently, we have been working on improving the game’s overall visual quality. From the fish scattered across the floor to the lighting and atmosphere inside the aquarium, we have been refining the scenery you will see as you play.
